paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在隐私保护人体感知综述中引用目标论文作为语音窃听的一个实例，但引文标记在正文中仅出现在列举参考文献的位置，没有对目标论文的具体能力（如亚毫米级、穿墙）作展开描述，属于普通引用。

evidences.evidence_quote: Eavesdropping on speech via IMU sensors, RF signals, and side-channel signals is widely investigated [50, 51, 52, 53].
evidences.evidence_context: In addition to identity information, the speech content in the audio signal also involves private information. ... Eavesdropping on speech via IMU sensors, RF signals, and side-channel signals is widely investigated [50, 51, 52, 53].

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用标记[51]出现在一组引文中，正文没有描述目标论文的具体贡献或能力，仅作为普通引用出现，属于grouped citation，不应被视为能力认可。根据规则，grouped citation需考虑attribution risk，故推荐exclude。
